verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair thing to expect from a payments API provider, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows a 'try it' console, an explorable reference, or runnable in-browser examples. The pack only shows prose docs, a webhook reference page, SDKs, a test-payment quickstart, and an llms.txt with markdown versions of pages; all probed OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404, so there is no machine-readable spec either.
